notes.title: Lust from Beyond: M Edition announced at E3!
notes.content:
For all of you who couldn’t put your hands on Lust from Beyond. 
For those who never heard about the dark, mysterious world of Lusst’ghaa.

[h3]We’ve just announced Lust from Beyond: M Edition at E3’s Future Game Show![/h3]

[previewyoutube=WCmgncH28yY;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]M Edition [/b]is a new version of Lust from Beyond, our esoteric survival horror. It’s tailored for those who love Lovecraftian stories for their atmosphere and lore rather than explicit content. 

If something stopped you from enjoying the base game, soon you’ll be able to immerse yourself into the world inspired by Lovecraft, Giger and Beksinski. 

Be prepared, it’s almost here. Add the game to your wishlist and follow.

notes.title: OUT NOW! With special DISCOUNTS!
notes.content:
This is the day, Cultists! [b]Lust from Beyond has cometh! [/b]
Grab it while it's hot, as we all know - it is hot, as hell itself!

Moreover, you can get the game with [b]up to 35% off[/b] for a week from launch. We have discounts that DO stack up. Details below, but first, the shiny new Launch Trailer…

[previewyoutube=oKSrkABgKB4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]...and let’s hear from Michał, our Game Director and Producer[/h2]

[i]“I'm happy and proud of Lust from Beyond. Personally, I'm tired of horror titles that circle around the same old themes. I'm happy to deliver a long, complex, fully independent production that goes against the mainstream and isn't afraid to get graphic, while staying focused on its narrative.”

“The development wasn't without its tougher moments. Fortunately, we've always had our fans' support. Their passion and encouragement kept up our fighting spirit. There are hundreds of posts on our Discord, about the lore, about the gameplay. Each gave us more strength and made us work even harder to meet the expectations. It's a game about lust, but we made it with love.”[/i]

- Our Launch Discount: 10% for EVERYONE, thanks to your engagement in the Community Challenge

notes.title: The Great Ritual Extended + Prize!
notes.content:
Beloved Cultists!

[b]The great lauv'abrarc needs more rituals from his followers.[/b] Therefore, [b]we are extending the contest until 29.01[/b] so that as many people as possible can participate in the challenge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30060957/f593cae8cc3c238647f74babd48746d2e7e4ef14.jpg[/img]

[h2]What you can win?[/h2]

A cultist from Ecstasy or Scarlet Lodge will capture the Flamingo Night Club in Bleakmoor for their assembly, tagging it with the symbol of the cult. What's more, the most creative person who performs the ritual will receive a [b]dakimakura with Amanda![/b]


[h2]REMINDER: How to participate?[/h2]

How to make a ritual:

notes.title: The Great Cults' War First Challenge
notes.content:
Cultists!

The lustful power of Lusst'ghaa has decided. [b]The Great One[/b] wants to choose the specific cult above the others, to prise it with his mercy and yet mysterious gift. That is why [b]Cult of Ecstasy[/b] and[b] the Scarlet Lodge[/b] have to begin their battle for the regards of Lustful God. The fate of the war will only be decided after the inevitable series of skirmishes and challenges.

Every battle results in the approval of[b] lauv'abrarc![/b] Which cult deserves more recognition in the eyes of [b]Lustful God[/b]? Only your actions can decide about your cult's fate! What will be your first battle?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30060957/d0426ab0783f230a92e77dee67145866d1a2157d.jpg[/img]

Acquaint with our [b]first Cults' War challenge, available only on our Discord!![/b] What would you give to your fellow Cultist as a holiday gift? Gather yourselves in your Cults, both [b]Scarlet[/b] and [b]Ecstasy[/b], and prepare holiday boxes, consisting of five items, which every Cultist should acquire. Be smart and creative, sex toys are not the only necessity in cultist's life. ;)

Deliberate inside your cults channels, choose your best propositions and send them to the [b]#war-of-cults[/b] channel and mention two hashtags in your posts: [b]#cultswar[/b] and [b]#scarlet[/b] or [b]#ecstasy[/b] cult, depending on your affiliation. The cultists appreciates uniqueness, and that's why the original, illustrated or handmade gifts will be more appreciated than those found in the shops (but it doesn't exclude them if they are worth changing cultists' mind :) ). 

We are waiting for your photos, pictures and/or other DIY stuff till [b]29th of December[/b]. The prise will be revealed pretty soon and it's worth waiting for!

[h2]To join your Cult, check our Discord server: https://discord.gg/8RuQquKrbe[/h2]

[b]Also, don't forget to check The Great Cults' War rules and regulations:[/b]

1. Respect each and every person. Don't insult anybody under any circumstances, equally in sent solved tasks and while discussing them your teams.

2. Every cult has the right to send only one task project in every challenge, so choose one person from your Cult who will be responsible for this

3. Try to stay tasteful - don't make your tasks vulgar, brutal or disrespectful for anybody. Works not complying with this point will not be accepted.

4. We reserve the right to use the submitted works for any purpose.

5. The works can be sent to the day specified in the tasks, until 23:59 CET.

notes.title: Lust from Beyond is coming to Kickstarter!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30060957/a5567647ca1618f87a33d369dafffad81beda021.png[/img]

[b]Dear cultists!
We are pleased to announce that on the 25th of April we are launching a kickstarter campaign for the game Lust from Beyond![/b] It's no secret that this is a big moment for us. Lately we have been painstakingly (and ecstatically) polishing the demo of our latest project, and we can't wait to show it to you.

Lust for Darkness was our first game, so we thank you for the trust you've given us. We are doing everything we can, to make our next creation better technically and artistically - we believe that this way, our blasphemous ideas will resonate even stronger! :) We hope that you can notice our progress at first glance after turning on the demo.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34600191/ab7565bd96614a576bc9e431a8d9d67534fb864b.jpg[/img]

But let's get down to specifics! 

[b]If you support us on Kickstarter you will be able to:[/b]

- get Lust from Beyond at a lower cost compared to the release price

- play an exclusive demo (right on the first campaign day!)

- receive additional content (wallpaper pack, artbook, soundtrack etc.)

- have an impact on the creation (e.g. by giving us feedback after playing the demo or more directly: by buying a reward allowing you to, for example, design your own ingame location!)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34600191/3320d03ef4472ec42edbe71ec97825ee1070c174.jpg[/img]

[b]IMPORTANT: for those who decide to support us on the first campaign day, there is a special reward that gives you the full game, the demo, and lots of additional content for a relatively low price! Also, this reward will contain an exclusive available only on the first day.[/b]

We have already gotten a lot of assurance of support on kickstarter, for which we thank you in advance! Remember, that by doing all that we contribute to the development of the erotic horror genre.

Also: we have a modest teaser for you - the full gameplay trailer will be out on the day the campaign starts.

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RjC_Pl8109g&feature=youtu.be]KICKSTARTER TEASER[/url]

[i]Willard Yelverton[/i]

notes.title: A COUPLE OF THOUGHTS FROM US, THE DEVELOPERS
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Before we write anything, we would like to thank you once again for buying and playing Lust for Darkness. Your comments, suggestions, reports and advice are all extremely valuable to us and we read them with humility.

We would like to take this opportunity to address several topics that you seem to be raising most frequently.

[h1]DURATION OF THE GAME[/h1]
When we were creating Lust for Darkness we wanted to tell a specific story. [b]We didn’t want to introduce any unnecessary fillers that wouldn’t add anything to the game world and we didn’t want to make the story longer just so that you spend more time with the game[/b]. If you take a close look, you can notice that [b]each level in Lust for Darkness serves a particular role[/b]. Adding a new section where a player escapes from monsters or coming up with a new puzzle that would take the player a lot of time to solve is not so difficult. But our priority wasn’t to make the game as long as possible. Our priority was to make the gameplay as immersive as possible with a smooth, satisfactory plot-line.

[h1]THE STORY[/h1]
“I finished the game but I still have questions that were left unanswered for me” was something we’ve heard from you relatively often…

Keeping the game in a mysterious vibe and at the same time handing all story piece to a player on a plate wouldn’t make much sense. With the main story, we wanted to focus on the relationship between Jonathan and Amanda, and leave other plotlines for those willing to explore our world more.

That is obviously related to Side Stories — by collecting 5 threads from each Side Story you will be able to see a cutscene that provides an additional explanation. If you already finished the game and don't feel like looking for Side Stories, we want to share one of them with you to give you a better sense of what they contain. From the video below, you will find out why Willard kidnapped Amanda. https://youtu.be/2uwgcoeILbU

It doesn’t end with Side Stories though. You can obtain some “secret information” in plenty of other ways. Who knows, maybe in the future we are going to shed more light on them… Including a full explanation of what really happened at the end of the game.

[h1]ISSUES IN THE GAME[/h1]
We understand that Lust for Darkness is not a perfect game and some of its elements, such as an optimization, could be better. However, please remember that we are an [b]independent studio consisting of only 6 people and this is our first game ever[/b]. Furthermore, none of our team members has really had any prior commercial experience in the videogame industry. We did our best with Lust for Darkness and we promise to get only better in the future. We are also still working on new updates for the game, the next one should introduce Steam Trading Cards, among other things.

[h1]THE IMPORTANCE OF REVIEWS FOR US[/h1]
We've already stated that a few times but we can't really stress it enough. [b]Reviews that you can submit on Steam are extremely important to us[/b]. Today, Lust for Darkness reached a [i]"Mixed"[/i] rating which caused our organic reach on Steam to drop drastically. And by drastically, we mean [b]really drastically[/b]. We are only [b]1% away[/b] from the [i]"Positive"[/i] score so any new positive review from you or, if you decide to change your review from a negative into a positive one, means A LOT to us.

Naturally, if you really dislike our game, we understand and respect it, and in this case we do not encourage you to change your score by any means. However, if you gave us a negative rating but you think that we've got some potential or you don't really know whether you can recommend our game or not, please reconsider your rating. A higher rating leads to better exposure on Steam, which in turn leads to higher sales, which ultimately will give us [b]more resources to make a better second game and continue working on developing the erotic horror genre[/b]. 

Thanks for your continuous support, we are both proud and humbled to have you as our community!

[i]Y'vh Iauv'abrarc. Y'vh Lusst'ghaa. 
Willard Yelverton[/i]

notes.title: [CONTEST] WILLARD YELVERTON helps you find all Side Stories
notes.content:
Dear Cultists,

My trained eye has noticed that you generally struggle with finding all [b]Side Stories[/b] in Lust for Darkness. I would like to make it easier for you by revealing in what spots they have been distributed. 

The description below may contain [b]spoilers[/b] so if you haven't finished the game yet, first complete the main story and then come back here to find out where you can find the Side Stories. (Hoover over the block with your mouse to see the text.)

[spoiler]
JONATHAN'S FLAT
- 1 thread of "Cult of Ecstasy" story

THE ENTRANCE ROOM (from entering the mansion till Amanda's room)
- 1 thread of “Yelvertons’ Legacy” story
- 1 thread of “Cult of Ecstasy” story

LUSST’GHAA (from when Jonathan stands up from the floor till the meeting with Amanda)
- 1 thread of “Cult of Ecstasy” story
- 1 thread of “Arcanes of Lusst’ghaa” story

THE CABINET (from the meeting with Amanda till the Willard's attack in his secret room)
- 3 threads of “Yelvertons’ Legacy” story

LUSST’GHAA 2 (from when Jonathan wakes up in Lusst’ghaa till the Stairs of Infinity)
- 1 thread of “Arcanes of Lusst’ghaa” story

THE GARDEN OF LOVE (from leaving the Stairs of Infinity till the Willard's pursuit)
- 2 threads of “Cult of Ecstasy” story

LUSST’GHAA 3 (from entering the portal after Willard's attack till the fight with Willard)
- 2 threads of “Arcanes of Lusst’ghaa” story

THE MONSTER ORGY (from the fight with Willard till descending into the cellar)
- 1 thread of “Arcanes of Lusst’ghaa” story

THE CELLAR (from descending into the cellar till the meeting with Amanda)
- 1 thread of “Yelvertons’ Legacy” story
[/spoiler]

Remember: collecting 5 threads from all Side Stories unlocks extra cutscenes that extend the lore of Lust for Darkness. You can watch this short bit from the “Yelvertons’ Legacy” Side Story to get the idea of what to expect:
https://youtu.be/v8D6fhHC2rs

To give you an extra motivation, the [b]first 10 people[/b] that post a screenshot from the game proving they have collected all Side Stories in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/523650/screenshots/]Screenshot section of our Steam Community Hub[/url] are going to receive [b]3 prizes[/b] from us: [i]a digital artbook, a wallpaper package and a Steam key[/i] for the game that you will be able to gift to your family member, a friend, or... a random stranger on the Internet.

Let the search begin!
[i]Y’vh Iauv’abrarc. Y’vh Lusst’ghaa.
Willard Yelverton[/i]

notes.title: The first UPDATE and a big THANK YOU!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30060957/b579c997472f7c13e70bdc133d084edbef3e5c2f.png[/img]

Dear Cultists,

It's been only 2 days since we released Lust for Darkness and we are extremely humbled to see such a big interest in the game. It's also [b]wonderful to read your enthusiastic opinions[/b] about the game, it makes all of us really happy!

We are [b]a very small team of just 6 people[/b] and this is our [b]first game created together[/b]. It looks like all the effort we've put into it over the last year (and beyond) paid off.

We can't wait for more of you to play Lust for Darkness, and in the meantime we prepared a first update for the game featuring:
- improved collisions system
- fixed glitches
- fixed typos
- improved difficulty level in the Garden of Love

We are currently working on [b]another update[/b], including an option to change the controls as well as Steam achievements. If you have suggestions for what else we should add in the future updates, let us know!

Additionally, if you liked the game, [b]please leave us a review[/b]. It improves our visibility on Steam significantly and naturally we want as many people as possible to find out about Lust for Darkness. 

Finally, we love reading your feedback, whether positive or negative, so keep it coming! [b]Your voice is of the highest priority to us[/b], both in terms of improving Lust for Darkness further and developing our next games. 

Y'vh Iauv'abrarc. Y'vh Lusst'ghaa. 
Willard Yelverton
